Example Federal Credit Union launches new digital banking platform

ANYTOWN, ST, February 10, 2026 — Example Federal Credit Union today launched a new digital banking platform for its members.

The new platform replaces a system first deployed in 2014 and adds real-time payment alerts, card controls and a redesigned loan application that can be completed in under ten minutes.

The credit union said 94 percent of active digital users had migrated to the new platform within the first three weeks.
